name: background
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, production game UI background. Create ONE exceptionally polished pixel-fantasy background for WizardCard's deck construction and deck editing screens, 16:9 landscape intended for 1920x1080. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its fine crisp pixel clusters, midnight navy stone, antique gold, cyan magic and warm candle contrast, but create a magical castle library interior instead of the outdoor balcony. A quiet moonlit arcane archive with tall stone arches, bookshelves and gold-bound books at the far left and right edges, subtle cyan crystal lanterns, a distant arched window showing the same moonlit castle silhouette. IMPORTANT composition for functional three-column UI overlay: the central 85 percent must be subdued, very dark navy, low contrast and nearly flat reading space; decoration should concentrate on the outermost edges and upper corners, with very faint shelf silhouettes only beneath panels. No desk or object across the card grid. Elegant atmospheric depth, no characters. Pixel art with deliberate small block clusters, crisp edges, richly crafted materials, no blurry painting, no 3D render. Fully opaque background, no UI panels, no buttons, no text, no card shapes, no logo, no watermark.

name: detail-panel
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup, production game UI component. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Generate ONE tall narrow rectangular card-detail panel for the WizardCard deck editor, matching the exact refined pixel-fantasy family: antique gold thin carved border, restrained cyan jewel accents in four corners, deep midnight-blue slightly textured opaque interior, crisp hand-designed pixel clusters, no painted blur. Proportion width:height 1:2.3. Outside the panel truly transparent alpha. The whole inside must be an uninterrupted clean dark reading surface for runtime card portrait and scrollable rules. NO card, NO illustration, NO inner slots, NO dividing lines, NO built-in button, NO writing, NO icons or labels. Straight edges and almost-square bevelled corners; ornaments should be compact, not invade reading area. Frame complete on all four sides, centered with transparent margins; orthographic front view. This will become a nine-slice Control texture in Godot, so long side rails must be simple and uniform, and all decorative detail must stay within small corners. Refined production-ready pixel art, transparent background, no shadow extending far outside.

name: grid-panel
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup, production game UI component. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate ONE reusable nearly square rectangular container skin for WizardCard's deck grids and card pool. Refined C-style fantasy PIXEL ART, antique gold slim carved rails, cyan small gems in four corners, dark midnight navy opaque uninterrupted interior with very subtle textile/stone microtexture. True transparent alpha outside the rectangle. Width:height roughly 1:1. Borders much slimmer than the reference, no large protruding ornaments, sharp orthographic front view, complete symmetric frame. This is a Godot nine-slice asset: corners contain all complex detail, horizontal and vertical rails are simple straight repeatable lines. Content should have extremely generous quiet empty space. NO internal grid, NO slots, NO card illustration, NO writing, NO buttons, NO divider, NO logo. Crisp deliberate pixel blocks, softly aged gold with clean bright pixel highlights, avoid watercolor, vector outline or 3D shine. Center the complete object with modest transparent margins.

name: list-entry
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup, production UI component. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate ONE long horizontal rectangular list-row skin for WizardCard deck management, refined C pixel-fantasy matching antique gold and cyan gem UI. Width:height 9:1, deep navy opaque interior, very thin old-gold border with restrained angular cyan crystal accents at far left and right. Full clean uninterrupted interior for a runtime portrait card cover on the left and two text lines beside it; no pre-cut hole, no card art, no internal divisions, no numbers, no text, no icons, no buttons. Straight top and bottom rails suitable for Godot nine-slicing, tiny ornate corners, all complex detail restricted to the two ends. High quality crisp pixel clusters, dark cobalt microtexture, mature elegant game UI. Entire object visible centered, true transparent alpha outside the row, no background scene, no watermark, no cast shadow.

name: empty-slot
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup, production game UI component. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate ONE portrait EMPTY card slot for a refined WizardCard deck builder, exact 3:4 silhouette, true transparent alpha outside. Very dark desaturated navy interior, faint geometrically symmetric arcane sigil at center only, recessed antique brass thin frame with small low-contrast cyan inlay corners. Empty slot should be deliberately MUCH more subdued than actual ornate gold card frames; crisp elegant pixel art, deliberate small pixel clusters, fine worn materials. Simple compact corners, no huge gems. No parchment, no illustration, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no labels. Orthographic straight front view, complete object centered with transparent margins. The slot holds runtime full portrait cards, so the entire quiet inner surface remains unobstructed. No background scene, no cast shadow outside silhouette, no watermark.

name: quantity-badge
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup, production game UI component. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate ONE small horizontally elongated EMPTY quantity badge for overlaying WizardCard card thumbnails. Pixel-fantasy antique gold bevelled outline with tiny cyan crystal accents at both ends, almost-black navy opaque blank center suitable for runtime text '2 / 3'. Aspect 2.2:1. Highly legible at about 52x24 game pixels, restrained simple silhouette, meticulous crisp pixel clusters, symmetrical. Transparent alpha outside. No text, no letters, no numbers, no icon inside, no actual card, no background. Center complete badge with transparent margins. This is a small functional corner counter rather than a huge decorative plaque: use thin gold line, small highlights and minimal ornamentation.

name: drop-highlight
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup, production game UI component. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate ONE portrait 3:4 rectangular DRAG DROP TARGET OUTLINE for WizardCard card editor. Entire interior must be completely transparent, entire exterior truly transparent. Only a slim glowing cyan rune border is visible, with four precise L-shaped corner brackets, tiny cyan crystalline corner accents and short subtle arcane dashes along straight rails; restrained antique gold edging on corner tips only. Designed to overlay either a single full card or stretch around a grid container. Perfectly symmetric orthographic front view, crisp fine pixel clusters. NO solid fill inside, NO background anywhere, NO letters or numbers, NO illustration, NO card frame or parchment, NO text. Cyan glow stays tight to the outline so it never obscures runtime card text. Complete isolated outline centered with generous transparent margins.
